# Canva Brand Kit — Polka Portals

Canva's API can read Brand Kits but cannot create them, so set this one up once by hand: **Canva → Brand → Add new → "Polka Portals"**. Every value below comes from the canon tokens.

## Colours (enter in this order)
| Name | Hex | Canon token | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ink black | `#151519` | `surface-inverse` | Frames, rails, terminals, body text (as ink-primary) |
| Paper | `#F6F5F2` | `surface-canvas` | Page background — the dominant field |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | `surface-primary` | Cards, panels, forms |
| Blood crimson | `#A0112B` | `accent-crimson` | One primary action, active states, crimson text on white |
| Hero crimson | `#B8143E` | `accent-hero` | Large art: brush cuts, splatter |
| Secondary ink | `#55525A` | `ink-secondary` | Captions, metadata |
| Sunken | `#ECEAE6` | `surface-sunken` | Wells, table headers |
| Crimson soft | `#FCE8EB` | `surface-crimson-soft` | Selected rows, highlights |
| Electric | `#EE5367` | `accent-electric` | Tiny points of light only — never text on light |

Rules: paper dominates (55–65 %), black frames (25–35 %), crimson is one point (5–10 %). Crimson text never sits on black; electric is never text.

## Fonts (all in Canva's font library)
| Brand role | Font | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Space Grotesk | Bold (700) |
| Subtitle / Heading | Space Grotesk | SemiBold (600) |
| Body | Inter | Regular (400) |
| Caption / labels / data | JetBrains Mono | Medium (500), uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06 em |

## Logos (upload from `30_ASSETS/brand`)
| Canva logo slot | File |
|---|---|
| Primary logo | `logo/polka-lockup-horizontal.svg` (on dark: `logo/polka-lockup-horizontal-inverse.svg`) |
| Stacked logo | `logo/polka-lockup-stacked.svg` |
| Shield (the mark alone) | `shield/polka-shield.svg` · PNG `shield/polka-shield-2048.png` |
| Shield, one colour | `shield/polka-shield-mono-ink.svg`, `shield/polka-shield-mono-paper.svg` |
| Small sizes / profile icon | `shield/polka-shield-small.svg`, `shield/polka-shield-badge.svg` |
| Wordmark | `wordmark/polka-wordmark.svg` (on dark: `-inverse.svg`) |
| Character art (not a logo) | `phantom-hero/phantom-emblem-2048.png` (on dark: `phantom-emblem-inverse-2048.png`) |

Clear space: a quarter of the emblem's width on every side. One Phantom per page.

## Graphics (upload from `30_ASSETS`)
Brush slash, brush stroke, ensō ring, splatter (ink, crimson), halftone fade, torn edge, HUD ring, target reticle, coordinate ruler, iso grid — at most three per page, one crimson, never behind text.
